feature: Bounded grapheme-aligned source text selection API

contract.range: Half-open chapter/block/source-byte locators, with text endpoints at extended grapheme boundaries

checks: Decomposed accents, ZWJ emoji, Hebrew, and source byte preservation
Rejected split graphemes, missing endpoints, empty/reversed ranges and image endpoints
Cross-block and cross-chapter ordering and separators
Image omission and late chapter failure
Exact output limit, overflow including separators, and pre-parse chapter-span bound
Extraction through actual TXT document parser
commands: nix-shell --run 'cargo fmt --all && cargo test --locked -p femto-reader --lib && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --features desktop,femto-catalog/tailnet --locked -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --all --check'

firmware_manifest.installation_status: No automatic installer. Verify the actual device partition table and recovery backup before installation.

limits: Frontend gestures, highlight rendering, clipping persistence/export and dictionaries are not implemented by this API.
Stored ranges require exact content identity supplied by their caller.
Output and chapter-count bounds do not establish peak parser heap or physical input latency.
Firmware compilation checks compatibility; the API is not yet invoked by firmware UI. The only source change during the build was adding a missing field in a cfg(test) fixture.
No native simulator, independent network, grayscale build or physical device run in this checkpoint.
